risks.risk_statement: Ambiguous release controls -> production instability during high-frequency deployments.
risks.mechanism: Overall assessment: insufficient release gating can propagate defects before rollback signals emerge.
evidence: Release notes show multiple emergency fixes after tightly packed deploy windows.
counter_signals: The team introduced feature flags that reduced impact in later periods.
risks.validation_suggestion: Ask which release checks were mandatory before each deployment group.
risks.confidence_rationale: Data indicates instability, though process improvements may have changed baseline risk.

risks.risk_statement: Weak escalation rehearsal -> slower recovery under concurrent incident load.
risks.mechanism: Rare practice of multi-incident drills can reduce coordination quality under pressure.
evidence: Postmortem notes mention confusion around communication ownership during overlap.
counter_signals: New playbooks have been drafted with clearer routing expectations.
risks.validation_suggestion: Request an incident narrative showing how communication ownership was assigned.
risks.confidence_rationale: Observed examples are limited and may not represent current process quality.
